title: HIV Stigma & Service Engagement Modeling
summary: This project models how social stigma, trust, and service access interact over time to shape HIV service uptake and retention.
approach: Translate qualitative systems maps into explicit state transitions and feedback loops.
Simulate intervention scenarios that target stigma reduction and improved service navigation.
Compare policy options using engagement, retention, and equity-focused outcomes.
currentFocus: Refining assumptions with stakeholder-informed pathways and preparing a calibrated implementation for scenario analysis.

title: Maternal Health & Service Delivery Redesign Modeling
summary: This work examines maternal care delivery pathways and redesign options to improve continuity, quality, and timeliness of care.
approach: Represent key patient flow and referral points across the service network.
Test resource and workflow redesign scenarios under realistic constraints.
Estimate expected effects on access, burden, and service performance.
currentFocus: Integrating facility-level constraints and implementation feasibility into model-driven redesign recommendations.

title: MSM Population Estimation
summary: This project develops robust estimates for MSM population size in settings with sparse or biased data sources.
approach: Combine survey, census-adjacent, and program data through model-based estimation.
Quantify uncertainty and compare assumptions across plausible scenarios.
Generate inputs suitable for planning models and intervention targeting.
currentFocus: Improving transportability across geographies and stress-testing assumptions in low-data contexts.

title: Reweighting & Bias Correction for Health Surveys
summary: This line of work improves inference from non-representative health survey data using calibration and reweighting methods.
approach: Apply IPF and raking to align samples with known population margins.
Assess sensitivity to missingness and measurement error assumptions.
Evaluate downstream impact on prevalence and intervention-effect estimates.
currentFocus: Building a reproducible workflow for survey calibration diagnostics and reporting.

title: Decision Dashboards for Health Systems
summary: This project turns model outputs into stakeholder-facing dashboards that support scenario comparison and planning decisions.
approach: Design decision-oriented views around priority outcomes and tradeoffs.
Expose assumptions and uncertainty in accessible, policy-relevant formats.
Support iterative stakeholder feedback loops for usability and trust.
currentFocus: Expanding scenario controls and simplifying uncertainty communication for non-technical audiences.

title: Intervention Evaluation for Funding Decisions
summary: This work evaluates intervention portfolios to inform resource allocation and funding prioritization decisions.
approach: Estimate comparative effectiveness under operational and budget constraints.
Assess cost-impact tradeoffs across candidate intervention bundles.
Produce transparent evidence summaries for funding deliberations.
currentFocus: Improving decision rules for prioritization under uncertainty and changing implementation conditions.
